_comment: Mutation testing: change the engine on purpose and see whether the tests notice. A green suite only proves the code ran; this proves the assertions have teeth. Scoped to the pure modules — the engine and the lib helpers — because those are what the tests actually cover; components are checked in a real browser instead (npm run visual).
_excluded: These four live in the DOM — keyboard listeners, focus, CSS custom properties — and are exercised by npm run keyboard and npm run a11y in a real browser rather than by vitest. Leaving them in scope would report them as untested when they aren't, and quietly drag the score around whenever one is edited.
